feature_note: SSDLite backbone ROI (672) + global (480) + person geometry (11) + frame-difference motion (38). Not shop_features_v1: no pose.
thresholds: per class, chosen on validation; stored inside model.pt

license.weights: derived from MERL Shopping (research and educational use only) and COCO-pretrained SSDLite (development_only)
license.source_media: MERL Shopping Dataset, research and educational use only

notes: Research model for observable shelf interactions on MERL's single overhead view. Not wired into the Shop runtime (configs/shop.yaml keeps the temporal module disabled). Outputs are uncalibrated action scores, never theft or intent scores. Does not cover hand_near_bag or item_visibility_lost.
